title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity bumps across python/ts/go
author: Jordan Reeves
description: This PR consolidates several SDK-level fixes and ergonomics improvements across Python, TypeScript, and Go: unified auth token refresh and retry middleware, parity and stability fixes for streaming APIs, and minor API ergonomics to bring method names and signatures in line across languages. Motivation: downstream clients see inconsistent retry semantics and streaming edge-cases (partial chunk handling, early EOF) across SDKs, making platform integrations brittle. Changes are split per-language but coordinated so release artifacts are aligned. See linked Linear tasks ENG-4821 and ENG-4833. Checklist: 1) Python: add AuthMiddleware with automatic token refresh, unify retry/backoff with common config, improve streaming iterator to surface partial events and reconnect semantics. 2) TypeScript: align stream event types, improve cancellation semantics on AbortSignal, fix edge-case where metadata frames were dropped. 3) Go: add retryable transport wrapper, expose StreamClient.ReadAll helper to match other SDK ergonomics. 4) Tests: add interop tests for streaming happy/path and reconnect, add unit tests for retry/backoff. 5) Version bumps for sdk-python 1.6.2, sdk-js 0.14.1, sdk-go 0.9.4. Notes: kept changes minimal in SDK surface to avoid breaking customers; introduced opt-in config knobs for aggressive retry strategies. This description is intentionally condensed; see commits/files for implementation details.

release_notes: Chore: unify SDK auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go; streaming parity and stability fixes; ergonomics improvements (StreamClient helpers, unified event types); version bumps: sdk-python 1.6.2, sdk-js 0.14.1, sdk-go 0.9.4. No breaking changes by default. Opt-in aggressive retry/backoff settings added.
